input.lugar: departure hall of a generic modern international airport in South America (not a real identifiable airport)
input.escena: the traveler's own hand holds a card-size identity document seen edge-on or from its plain back, together with a folded boarding pass; ahead, out of focus, a calm queue of travelers with backpacks moves toward distant border-control desks in a wide, bright hall with tall windows. It reads as the moment of leaving the country, not as a stressful procedure
input.clima: natural daylight entering through tall windows
input.fotografo: waits in the queue holding the document at chest height in the upper part of the frame, looking down at his own hand
input.mirada: the document and boarding pass in the traveler's hand
input.prohibir: readable document data, photo or number, real ID card design, PDI or airport signage, readable boarding pass text, faces in focus, airline uniforms
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the hand with the document is raised to the traveler's eye line; hand and document sit only in the upper-centre zone between 15% and 47% of the frame height and between 36% and 64% of the width. The queue ahead is small and distant in that same upper band. The lower half shows only polished floor and the very out-of-focus backpack strap, calm and mid-dark, with no hands or faces. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 50 mm equivalent, close lived detail of hands and objects, intimate without isolating them from the place.
